title: Mobility: stale member refs and group freeze on node kill
description: No member-removal API: killing the anchor node leaves the pattern attached under a dead id so the whole group freezes (step_all skips missing node), killing a member leaves a strong stale ref in GroupMobility._members/RPGM members and set_position is called on the dead node every step (mobility.py:314, :565). Also runner kill events never detach patterns (scenario.py:353-355). Fix: remove_member/detach-on-kill in MobilityManager + pattern member pruning; tests for kill-anchor, kill-member mid-sim.
